customManagers.description: Alpine release embedded in compound base image tags such as python:3.12-alpine3.23. The dockerfile manager treats everything after the first hyphen as a compatibility marker and never moves it, which is how these stranded on alpine3.23 while the standalone alpine images reached 3.24.

packageRules.description: Pin digests for all docker images.

The embedded Alpine release sits mid-tag, so there is no digest to attach to it; the digest belongs to the whole image and is pinned by the rule above. Grouped into one PR because #24 standardised these deliberately, so they should move together rather than drift apart per image.
Automerge patch+digest only for 0.x, where a minor is allowed to break.

Base runtimes and the OS: a minor here is a language release line or OS release change, not a routine bump, and the two ignores this config replaces existed to keep exactly these reviewable. Patches and digests still automerge.
